Politics · India

Trump likely to visit India early next year, trade deal discussed

Former US President Donald Trump is likely to visit India early next year, according to US Senator Marco Rubio. Rubio also indicated that a trade deal between India and the US is on track. The US envoy highlighted the strong partnership between the two nations and India's growing global influence under Prime Minister Modi.
